requirements.reason: The accepted authorization matrix must remain the source of truth for the 15 game, community, roster, chat, public catalog, and Need-a-Sub relationship route families and 64 C-owned route keys.

C-owned routes must preserve the approved dependency and verified-email distinction between public reads, authenticated relationship reads, active-account reads, and verified-user relationship mutations.

Public game, community-detail, venue, venue-image, game-image, and Need-a-Sub reads must expose only public/listable records and public response fields unless a source-defined relationship permits private visibility.

Current-user relationship reads for bookings, checkout status, game participants, waitlist entries, My Games, Need-a-Sub owned posts, requests, and history must bind to the authenticated user or source-defined relationship.

Game roster, checkout, guest, cancel, and host-edit mutations must enforce current verified-user relationship, host/player role, game state, lifecycle window, capacity, duplicate-state, and saved-card compatibility boundaries.

Community-game publish and community-detail host-edit behavior must bind to the current verified host, current game state, accepted host-payment rules, publish-attempt ownership, and public concealment of hidden payment text or host-only fields.

Game chat and chat-message routes must prove membership authorization, sender binding, read-state binding, hidden or removed message concealment, nonmember denial, and separation from D-owned admin moderation breadth.

Need-a-Sub post, request, status-history, position, and scoped chat routes must enforce post owner, requester, public viewer, confirmed-chat-member, lifecycle-window, sender, and read-state boundaries.

Field and mass-assignment proof must cover every C-owned write surface where caller input could affect identity, ownership, relationship state, payment or provider identity, moderation state, visibility, read-state, or server-controlled fields.

Negative/default-deny proof must cover 401 unauthenticated or invalid credentials, 403 forbidden relationships or states, concealed 404 behavior, wrong IDs, caller-controlled actor substitution, and rejected mutations with no prohibited side effects.

Requirement declarations, pytest markers, matrix checks, test names, and the testing record must remain traceable to the frozen C plan, the approved intake, accepted A/B artifacts, current source, and accepted predecessor repository evidence.

D-owned admin/high-risk route proof, minimum-necessary admin data, sensitive export/unmask/read-audit policy, durable Stripe/webhook/provider reconciliation, real provider/runtime evidence, genuine database-concurrency closure, moderation closeout, and final parent-gap disposition are outside WS03-04C and must have zero local pytest mappings.
